scripts.build: dart pub get && dart compile js -O2 -o lib/bundle.js bin/index.dart && npx node-preamble lib/bundle.js > lib/index.js && rm -f lib/bundle.js lib/bundle.js.map lib/bundle.js.deps
scripts.watch: dart compile js -O1 -o lib/bundle.js bin/index.dart && npx node-preamble lib/bundle.js > lib/index.js && rm -f lib/bundle.js lib/bundle.js.map lib/bundle.js.deps
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
